featured_reviews.name: Samrat Chokshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Unprofessional, misleading, and not worth the money. Strongly advise to ignore the positive reviews here.

We had a genuinely poor experience with Painting Drive and would strongly advise others to think twice.

To start with, the timeline was incorrectly communicated to us. What was promised upfront versus what actually happened were two very different things, and this caused unnecessary stress and delays.

We were clearly told that a patch test would be done so we could approve the finish before proceeding. Instead, at the end of Day 1, we were bluntly told the work was already done and nothing could be changed, even though it was NOT what we had agreed on. That’s not how professional services work. If you are promising a patch test on the wall, you need to do that and only proceed ahead if the client is okay with it and not leave the client hanging and says “it is what it is”.

Tripur from Painting Drive was extremely unprofessional and rude throughout. He refused to take accountability at every level, brushed off concerns, and showed zero willingness to correct mistakes. When we asked for changes, they were outright refused.

Basic coordination was also missing. Something as simple as handing over the house keys to another vendor was ignored. Painting Drive ended up hoarding the keys, blocking access for other vendors and disrupting parallel work at our home.

The quality of work itself was poor - unclean, careless, and far from professional standards. Despite this, we were charged an exorbitant amount, completely unjustified for the quality delivered.

Overall, this was a frustrating, disappointing experience marked by poor communication, lack of accountability, and bad workmanship. Definitely not recommended.
